result.title: FADE: Factored Ability--Difficulty Filtering for Online RLVR Scheduling
result.summary: Group-based reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) learns only from prompts whose sampled completions disagree: all-pass and all-fail groups produce zero relative advantage and burn generation budget without moving the policy. Adaptive schedulers try to steer rollouts toward informative prompts, yet they rely on per-prompt pass-rate trackers that entangle two quantities evolving at very different speeds---the policy's shifting competence across reasoning skills and each prompt's intrinsic difficulty. When a single exponential average or Beta counter tracks both at once, short memory scrambles the relative ordering of prompts whereas long memory reports stale pass rates. We introduce FADE (Factored Ability--Difficulty Estimation), a bilinear state-space filter that separates the two timescales. FADE represents each prompt's success logit as the inner product of a whitened $K$-dimensional skill loading with a fast-drifting policy ability vector, minus a slow-shrinking scalar item intercept. Using Pólya--Gamma augmentation, each minibatch of binary rollout outcomes updates the $K$-dimensional ability posterior in closed form via a rank-$K$ Woodbury step, instantly transferring competence shifts to all unobserved prompts that share those skills while leaving item intercepts stable. From the resulting posterior mean and variance we derive a closed-form utility for the probability of drawing a non-degenerate rollout group. Across five reasoning benchmarks, two base models, and four scheduling paradigms under a matched rollout budget, FADE consistently improves downstream accuracy and calibration while adding less than $0.6$\,ms per step.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 FADE，用双线性状态空间滤波把每个 prompt 的通过率拆成快速变化的策略能力向量与缓慢变化的题目难度截距，并以 Pólya–Gamma 增广闭式更新能力后验，据此计算采样出非退化 rollout 组的效用，用于在线 RLVR 的 prompt 调度。
AI.relevance_reason: 其将「模型能力」与「样本固有难度」分时标度解耦并估计后验不确定性，可能为 latent 推理训练中筛选有信息量样本、区分任务难度与模型收益、以及 THINK/LOOK/STOP 增益的校准评价提供可供核查的线索。
